## Template Used

LACDR-ISA - Assay (General) v1.0.0

## Title

`r rmarkdown::metadata$title`

## Date (dd-MM-yyyy)

`r format(Sys.time(), format = "%d-%m-%Y")`

## Description or Purpose

To combine all results from MOFA into an Excel Supplementary Table.

### Data sources

- Figure 1 MOFA factors - contributions from cell lines
- Figure 1 MOFA factor weights - feature weights for each factor

## Results

### Preparations

#### Load R libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(writexl)
```

#### Custom functions

```{r}
source(here("code/functions/helpers.R"))
```

#### Set input and output directories

Show base path to the project that is used in the analysis.

```{r}
here()
```

Set output data directory and create if it does not exist.

```{r}
datestamp <- get_datestamp()
output_dir <- set_output_dir(here("manuscript", str_glue("Tables_{datestamp}")))
```
### Open MOFA factors and weights from Figure 1

```{r}
factors <- read_csv(here("manuscript/Figure1_20260901/Figure1BC.csv"))

dim(factors)
head(factors)
```

```{r}
weights <- read_csv(here("manuscript/Figure1_20260901/Figure1DE.csv"))

dim(weights)
head(weights)
```

### Write to supplementary Table

```{r}
excel_sheets <- list(
  "factors" = factors,
  "weights" = weights
)
write_xlsx(excel_sheets, here(output_dir, "Supplementary_Table_2.xlsx"))
```
